1.text: Indi nzara itera muri icyo gihugu, itari iyateraga mbere Aburahamu akiriho. Isaka ajya i Gerari kwa Abimeleki, umwami w'Abafilisitiya.

2.text: Uwiteka aramubonekera aramubwira ati “Ntumanuke ngo ujye muri Egiputa, uzature mu gihugu nzakubwira.

3.text: Suhukira muri iki gihugu, nanjye nzabana nawe, nguhe umugisha kuko wowe n'urubyaro rwawe nzabaha ibi bihugu byose, kandi nzakomeza indahiro narahiye Aburahamu so.

4.text: Kandi nzagwiza urubyaro rwawe ruhwane n'inyenyeri zo mu ijuru, kandi nzaha urubyaro rwawe ibi bihugu byose. Kandi mu rubyaro rwawe ni mo amahanga yose yo mu isi azaherwa umugisha,

5.text: kuko Aburahamu yanyumviraga, akitondera ibyo namwihanangirije n'ibyo nategetse, n'amategeko yanjye nandikishije n'ayo navuze.”

7.text: Abantu b'aho bamubaza iby'umugore we, arabasubiza ati “Ni mushiki wanjye”, kuko yatinye kuvuga ati “Ni umugore wanjye.” Ati “Abantu b'aha be kunyica bampora Rebeka”, kuko yari umunyagikundiro.

8.text: Amazeyo igihe kirekire, Abimeleki umwami w'Abafilisitiya arungurukira mu idirishya, abona Isaka akinisha umugore we.

9.text: Abimeleki ahamagaza Isaka aramubwira ati “Biragaragara yuko ari umugore wawe, ko wavuze uti ‘Ni mushiki wanjye’?”Isaka aramusubiza ati “Ni uko nibwiraga nti ‘Be kunyica bamumpora.’ ”

10.text: Abimeleki aramubaza ati “Ibyo watugize ibyo ni ibiki? Byashigajeho hato umwe mu bantu banjye akaryamana n'umugore wawe, ukadushyirishaho icyaha.”

11.text: Abimeleki yihanangiriza abantu be bose ati “Uzakura uyu mugabo cyangwa umugore we ntazabura gucirwaho iteka.”

12.text: Isaka abiba muri icyo gihugu, muri uwo mwaka yeza ibirutaho incuro ijana. Uwiteka amuha umugisha.

13.text: Uwo mugabo aba umukire, agenda arushaho, ageza aho yabereye umukire cyane.

14.text: Yari afite imikumbi n'amashyo n'abagaragu benshi, atera Abafilisitiya ishyari.

15.text: Amariba yose abagaragu ba se bafukuye, Aburahamu se akiriho, Abafilisitiya bari bayashibishije ibitaka.

16.text: Abimeleki abwira Isaka ati “Genda utuvemo, kuko uturuta cyane.”

17.text: Isaka avayo, abamba amahema ye mu gikombe cy'i Gerari, aturayo.

18.text: Isaka asibūza amariba bafukuye, Aburahamu se akiriho, kuko Abafilisitiya bari bayasibye, Aburahamu amaze gupfa. Ayita amazina se yayise.

19.text: Abagaragu ba Isaka bafukura muri icyo gikombe, babonamo iriba ry'amazi adudubiza.

20.text: Abashumba b'i Gerari batonganira ayo mazi n'aba Isaka, bati “Ni ayacu.” Isaka yita iryo riba Eseki, kuko bamugishije impaka.

21.text: Bongera gufukura irindi riba, na ryo bararitonganira, aryita Sitina.

22.text: Avayo afukuza irindi riba, ryo ntibaritonganira, aryita Rehoboti, aravuga ati “None Uwiteka adushyize ahāgutse, natwe tuzororokera muri iki gihugu.”

24.text: Uwiteka amubonekera iryo joro aramubwira ati “Ndi Imana ya so Aburahamu, ntutinye kuko uri kumwe nanjye, kandi nzaguha umugisha, ngwize urubyaro rwawe ngiriye umugaragu wanjye Aburahamu.”

25.text: Yubakayo igicaniro, yambaza izina ry'Uwiteka, abambayo ihema rye, kandi abagaragu ba Isaka bahafukura n'iriba.

26.text: Maze Abimeleki ava i Gerari, ajyana aho ari na Ahuzati incuti ye, na Fikoli umutware w'ingabo ze.

27.text: Isaka arababaza ati “Ni iki kibazanye aho ndi kandi munyanga, mwaranyirukanye aho muri?”

28.text: Baramusubiza bati “Twabonye neza yuko Uwiteka ari kumwe nawe, turavuga tuti ‘Dushyire indahiro hagati yacu nawe, kandi dusezerane nawe

29.text: yuko utazatugirira nabi, nk'uko natwe tutakwakuye, ahubwo twakugiriye neza gusa, tugusezeraho amahoro.’ None uhiriwe ku Uwiteka.”

30.text: Nuko Isaka abatekera ibyokurya bararya, baranywa.

31.text: Bazinduka kare bararahiranya, Isaka arabasezerera bamusiga amahoro.

32.text: Kuri uwo munsi abagaragu ba Isaka baraza, bamubwira iby'iriba bafukuye, bati “Tubonye amazi.”

33.text: Aryita Sheba. Ni cyo gituma uwo mudugudu witwa Bērisheba na bugingo n'ubu.

34.text: Esawu amaze imyaka mirongo ine avutse arongora Yuditi mwene Beri Umuheti, na Basemati mwene Eloni Umuheti,

35.text: bababaza imitima ya Isaka na Rebeka.
